result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane signalized intersection that is significantly lacking in pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no visible crosswalk markings or pedestrian signals, forcing people to cross a wide expanse of asphalt with high exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, making pedestrians less visible and their path unpredictable to drivers.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals are visible to indicate when it is safe for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance without a refuge island, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a median or refuge island.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane divided roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk that lacks signalized control or a protected pedestrian refuge. The environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle traffic and long pedestrian exposure distances, creating a hostile environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic with significant exposure time and no protected refuge in the center.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Uncontrolled High-Speed Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks traffic signals or stop signs to manage vehicle flow on a road designed for high speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised, ADA-compliant refuge island in the median to allow for a two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.
